objective: Preallocate window partition index buckets for their first row index.

tasks.title: Preallocate window partition buckets
tasks.result: Window partition grouping now creates new row-index buckets with capacity for the immediately inserted first index.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The first cargo test attempt failed before running tests because target debug symbol files filled the E: drive; Cargo-generated PDB files under target/debug were removed after path verification.
The bucket capacity is 1 because a new window partition is immediately followed by the first row index push.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for new window partition buckets; partition key evaluation, ordering, and window function semantics are unchanged.
